description: This file defines the Interpolator class used for injecting config values into strings by replacing tokens with corresponding data. It includes methods for setting data, adding data, interpolating strings, and finding tokens within strings.

classes.name: Interpolator
classes.description: A class for replacing tokens in strings with data from an associative array, supporting customizable token delimiters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Interpolator with optional start and end token delimiters.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data array used for interpolation.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Merges additional data into the existing data array.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Replaces tokens in a message with corresponding data values, with optional extra data and default value for missing tokens.

methods.name: replacements
methods.description: Builds an array of token replacements based on the message and data.

methods.name: findTokens
methods.description: Finds all tokens in a message based on the configured delimiters.
